interface.name: zsingularity_pip_manager_v1
interface.description: This privileged interface creates and controls a compositor-owned live picture-in-picture view. Only one picture-in-picture view is active at a time.

request.name: show_toplevel
request.description: Replaces the active picture-in-picture view with the complete content of the supplied toplevel.

request.name: show_region
request.description: Selects the front-most mapped toplevel intersecting the global layout rectangle and shows the intersecting part of that toplevel.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroying this binding does not close the active picture-in-picture view.
